Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The Sooty_Mould reference matches very closely: dark black/sooty irregular patches scattered across the green leaf surface, with a coated/dirty appearance rather than discrete necrotic spots. The test image shows the same pattern — black sooty deposits unevenly distributed on the leaf.
